phases.label: BRISK WARM-UP WALK
phases.instruction: Walk briskly for five minutes and prepare to run easily.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare for an easy continuous run.
phases.completionInstruction: Run continuously for 35 minutes at an easy pace.

phases.label: CONTINUOUS EASY RUN
phases.instruction: Run continuously for 35 minutes at an easy pace.
phases.cue: Easy pace. Stay controlled, keep your stride relaxed, and slow down if the run begins to feel like a race.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare for the cool-down walk.
phases.encouragement: Easy pace. Stay controlled, keep your stride relaxed, and slow down if the run begins to feel like a race.
phases.completionInstruction: Walk easily for five minutes to cool down.

phases.label: COOL-DOWN WALK
phases.instruction: Walk easily for five minutes to cool down.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Keep walking easily.
phases.completionInstruction: Session complete. Continue walking until you feel settled.
